description: Elections Commission - K. M. B. P. Kumari of the Kolonnawa Urban Council has vacated his office of the member of United National Party - W. M. D. G. Nalin of the Kolonnawa Urban Council has vacated his office of the member of the United National Party
reasoning: This gazette content contains a notice under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that specific individuals have vacated their office as Members of the Kolonnawa Urban Council due to ceasing membership in a political party.
